questions.subject: भूगोल
questions.q: पर्यटन भूगोलबारे कुन कथन ठीक छ?

प्राकृतिक तथा सांस्कृतिक आकर्षणको अवस्थिति, पहुँच र पूर्वाधारले पर्यटनको विकासमा प्रभाव पार्न सक्छ
पर्यटन गतिविधि भूगोलबाट पूर्ण रूपमा स्वतन्त्र हुन्छ

questions.subject: भूगोल

options: आर्थिक अवसरलाई पूर्ण रूपमा बेवास्ता गर्नु
रोजगारी, शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य र सेवा-सुविधाका अवसरलाई गन्तव्यको भौगोलिक अवस्थासँग जोडेर हेर्नु
questions.explanation: बसाइँसराइ बुझ्दा आर्थिक, सामाजिक र भौगोलिक pull/push factors लाई समग्र रूपमा हेर्नुपर्छ।

questions.q: प्राकृतिक स्रोत र आर्थिक विकासबारे कुन भनाइ गलत छ?

स्रोतको दिगो व्यवस्थापन विकाससँग सम्बन्धित हुन्छ

questions.question: Statement: An institution requires applicants to submit documents through a single verified portal rather than by email. Conclusions: I. The institution seeks a more controlled submission process. II. Email can never be secure.

questions.question: Statement: A pilot program in three districts reduced average document-processing time by 18%, while staffing levels remained unchanged. Conclusions: I. The pilot may have improved process efficiency. II. The same 18% reduction will necessarily occur everywhere.
questions.solution: The observed result supports a possible efficiency improvement. It cannot guarantee an identical result elsewhere.

questions.question: Is employee P older than employee Q? Statement I: P is older than R. Statement II: R is older than Q.

Both are true and R explains A
questions.solution: The reason directly explains the internal-control benefit of separation of duties.

questions.question: Five reports P, Q, R, S and T are arranged from first to last. P is before R. Q is after S. T is before P. Which report can be first?
